body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Lisbon, Portugal. It starts at Av. Eusébio da Silva Ferreira.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Discover 29 thematic areas across three floors inside the Benfica Museum, highlighting sports achievements, historic locations, and key figures in the Club’s history.
>
> Explore at your own pace with QR codes providing additional information and guides available for any questions.
>
> Learn about Lisbon and Portugal's history, and enjoy interactive features like tactile surfaces, a simulator, and a penalty shootout experience.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €16.86. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 14 ratings and 8 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
